propositions: The readiness gate that polls /rest/api/2/serverInfo for a 200 response does not guarantee custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are registered, allowing a timing flake to be misattributed to image degradation.

Both the live-DC harness and probe workflows declare readiness identically via serverInfo 200, but _assert_project_capabilities asserts the presence of plugin-provided custom fields much later, creating a latent flake when the fixture runs before field registration completes.

The probe workflow measured this defect in run 30944211742: serverInfo went green at 8m32s, but one second later the field inventory contained zero customfield_* entries despite authorization and well-formed queries.

The harness survives only by accident—it performs slower setup work after readiness, allowing time for fields to register—not by any safety mechanism, making it vulnerable to flaking under faster execution paths.

A system-only field inventory (no customfield_* entries) must be treated as NOT-READY rather than as a degraded image, with a self-diagnosing failure message that distinguishes 'not registered yet' from 'does not offer by this image'.
